logic.top_level: pathways (secondary prevention any-of 6 groups; primary prevention any-of 6 groups; children any-of 4; S-ICD an ALL/NONE-of list)

k_of_n.quote: considered medically necessary for the secondary prevention of sudden cardiac death for ANY of the following indications
considered medically necessary for the primary prevention of sudden cardiac death for ANY of the following indications

In an individual that is post-MI (>= 40 days) with ischemic cardiomyopathy ... ANY of the following: LVEF <= 30% NYHA class I; LVEF <= 35% NYHA class II or III; LVEF <= 40% NSVT with EPS showing inducible sustained VT/VF
Hypertrophic cardiomyopathy (HCM) with 1 or more risk factors
has NONE of the following: symptomatic bradycardia; incessant ventricular tachycardia (VT); spontaneous frequent recurring VT reliably terminated with anti-tachycardia pacing
Nonischemic cardiomyopathy (NICM) due to a Lamin A/C mutation with 2 or more risk factors (e.g., NSVT, LVEF <45%, non-missense mutation, male sex)

logic.exclusions_or_contraindications: No exclusion list. Closing sentences: 'A transvenous ICD is considered not medically necessary for ANY other indication', and a closed S-ICD rule. S-ICD uses 'NONE of the following' (3 items). Substernal ICD is blanket experimental. No survival-more-than-one-year gate.
logic.initial_vs_repeat: 'Replacement of a transvenous ICD pulse generator and/or leads is considered medically necessary.' No conditions, no end-of-life test.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: In an individual that is post-acute myocardial infarction (MI) (> 48 hours and < 40 days) and/or revascularization (< 90 days), with LVEF <= 40% and BOTH of the following: Nonsustained ventricular tachycardia (NSVT); Inducible sustained VT at electrophysiological (EP) study
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'and/or' between MI window and revascularization window; this early post-MI ICD pathway contradicts Florida Blue's investigational statement for MI less than 40 days.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Individual with unexplained syncope due to ANY of the following: Cardiac sarcoidosis with documented spontaneous sustained ventricular tachycardia; Ischemic heart disease with inducible sustained monomorphic VT on electrophysiological study; ... Structural heart disease (e.g. prior MI) with LVEF <= 35%
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'due to ANY of the following' makes the listed conditions the causes of syncope; elsewhere they act as diagnoses. Also 'Nonischemic dilated cardiomyopathy, LVEF <= 49%' sets a threshold far above other payers' 35%.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Individual without structural heart disease (left ventricular ejection fraction [LVEF] > 50%) or known genetic causes of sustained VT/VF and EITHER of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'without structural heart disease ... or known genetic causes': is the 'or' a second excluded thing or a second condition to be satisfied? And LVEF > 50% leaves exactly 50 uncovered, while elsewhere structural disease is defined as LVEF < 50%.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Individual with syncope of suspected arrhythmic cause and ANY of the following: ... Long QT Syndrome (LQTS) and EITHER of the following: syncope while receiving beta-blockers; beta-blockers are contraindicated
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: A three-level nested list inside an ANY list; the EITHER binds only to LQTS.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: A transvenous ICD is considered medically necessary in a child with ANY of the following
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: 'child' not defined by age; adult/child split is by population label.

and_or_ambiguity.quote: Replacement of a transvenous ICD pulse generator and/or leads is considered medically necessary.
and_or_ambiguity.why_ambiguous: Unconditional; replacement of a device that was never medically necessary (outside these criteria) or after a covered explant is not distinguished.

Myotonic dystrophy; Chagas disease; Acute lymphocytic myocarditis, newly diagnosed (< 3 months); Giant cell myocarditis; Peripartum cardiomyopathy, persists > 3 months postpartum, LVEF <= 35%
LV thickness >= 30 mm by echocardiography or cardiovascular magnetic resonance (CMR) imaging; Extensive late gadolinium enhancement (LGE) on CMR
A transvenous ICD is considered medically necessary in a child with ANY of the following

LVEF <= 40% NSVT with EPS showing inducible sustained VT/VF

time_windows.quote: at least 3 months on guideline-directed medical therapy

time_windows.length: more than 48 hours, less than 40 days

codes.codes_tied_to_criteria: Four short tables, each headed 'Considered Medically Necessary when criteria in the applicable policy statements listed above are met' (33224, 33225, 33249; C1883; S-ICD 33270; AED E0617) or 'Experimental/Investigational/Unproven' (0571T). Generator-only codes (33230, 33231, 33240, 33262-33264) and lead codes are not listed even though replacement is covered in the text.

This Coverage Policy addresses the use of transvenous implantable cardioverter defibrillators, subcutaneous implantable cardioverter defibrillators, substernal implantable cardioverter-defibrillators, wearable cardioverter-defibrillators, and automatic external defibrillators in the home setting.

extraction_hazards: Roughly 30 of 42 pages are Background; the Overview names wearable defibrillators as covered topics though the statement was removed 7/15/2026; a keyword search for 'wearable' finds only the Overview and the revision log.
Bullet glyphs and nesting up to four levels (o, square) lose indentation.
Overview/coverage statement mixes adults and children under one heading; 'child' not defined by age.
Page footer 'Medical Coverage Policy: 0431 / Page n of 42' splits lists across pages (pages 2-4).
Codes list does not cover the procedures the text covers (e.g., 33230-33231 generator insertion absent).
Related Coverage Resources sidebar and two-column table of contents on page 1.
interesting_structures: Largest number of distinct patient groups of the five payers; groups unique to Cigna: myotonic dystrophy, Chagas disease, giant cell myocarditis, newly diagnosed lymphocytic myocarditis, peripartum cardiomyopathy, cardiac amyloidosis, LV non-compaction, tetralogy of Fallot, familial dilated NICM.
Early post-MI primary prevention (more than 48 hours, under 40 days) allowed when NSVT and inducible VT, and for MI patients needing pacing.
Unexplained syncope pathway with LVEF <= 49% in nonischemic dilated cardiomyopathy.
S-ICD defined by NONE-of three exclusions; no vascular access justification needed.
AED at home covered when the person meets ICD criteria but is not currently a candidate (device-substitute logic).
Policy was merged from CP 0181 in 2024; wearable defibrillator statement removed 2026.

fit_to_tree.scale: 1 = clean, 5 = needs new constructs or human judgment
fit_to_tree.why: Pure any-of pathways with numeric leaves, expressible. Strain: many pathways with subtle overlaps and contradictions in thresholds, 'and/or' in the early post-MI window, 'due to ANY' syncope wording, undefined GDMT/structural heart disease, and 'NONE of' for S-ICD (a NOT over any).
